Job Title


Deputy Manager\-Production ( Drug Product )
Job Description


The incumbent is responsible for ensuring compliance with cGMP requirements and supporting the smooth execution of production operations through effective documentation, quality systems, validation, and compliance activities. The role involves maintaining manufacturing records in compliance with data integrity requirements, coordinating with cross\-functional teams, managing GMP documentation, supporting audits, qualification and validation activities, reviewing production records and defect trends, handling SAP, ENSUR, and TrackWise system activities, and driving safety and training initiatives. The position plays a key role in maintaining regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement within the production function.
Job Summary\*\*  

  

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Deputy Manager\-Production to oversee and optimize drug product manufacturing operations at our state\-of\-the\-art facility. This role involves ensuring efficient production, maintaining quality standards, and leading a team to achieve production targets.  

  

Job Responsibilities\*\*  

  

* Supervise and manage all aspects of drug product manufacturing, including compounding, filling, lyophilization, and packaging, ensuring compliance with cGMP regulations and company SOPs.
* Develop and implement production schedules, monitor progress, and troubleshoot any deviations to meet production targets and deadlines.
* Lead, mentor, and train a team of production operators and supervisors, fostering a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Engineering, and Supply Chain departments to resolve manufacturing issues, implement process improvements, and ensure timely availability of materials and equipment.
* Conduct investigations into deviations, non\-conformances, and CAPAs, identifying root causes and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions.
* Review and approve batch records, production reports, and other relevant documentation to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Participate in regulatory inspections and audits, providing necessary documentation and support.
* Identify and implement opportunities for process optimization, cost reduction, and efficiency improvement within the production department.
* Ensure all safety protocols and environmental regulations are strictly adhered to within the production area.

  

Job Qualifications\*\*  

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Technology, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* 5\-8 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, with a minimum of 2\-3 years in a supervisory or managerial role within drug product production (sterile or non\-sterile).
* Strong understanding and practical application of cGMP, ICH guidelines, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Proven experience in aseptic processing, filling operations, and lyophilization is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to motivate, develop, and manage a diverse team.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and decision\-making abilities.
* Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in using manufacturing execution systems (MES) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) software.

Bachelor of Science (BSc)cGMP Requirements, Manufacturing Operations, QMS Documentation, Quality Management Systems (QMS)

jobs.description:
Senior Business Analyst – Next Gen Data Integration Project


Summary


The Senior Business Analyst will play a key role in the modernization of the firm's enterprise data ecosystem, supporting cloud\-native data integration, data warehousing, and analytics initiatives. The role will partner with business and technology teams to define requirements and deliver scalable, secure, and configurable cloud\-based data solutions leveraging platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, SQL Server, Oracle, and modern ETL/ELT technologies.


The Senior Business Analyst will focus on enterprise data integration workflows across source systems, ETL/ELT processes, data warehouse platforms, and financial data domains. The role will help define requirements for ingestion, transformation, validation, mapping, reconciliation, lineage, monitoring, exception handling, and data distribution capabilities across platforms such as Snowflake, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and related ETL/data integration tools.


They must be comfortable working at the intersection of business, data, and technology, with the ability to translate complex financial data needs into clear business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, source\-to\-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans. The ideal candidate will have strong Agile delivery experience, excellent communication skills, and the ability to bridge business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver scalable, configurable, and supportable enterprise data integration solutions.

* Partner with data architects and engineering teams to define ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment, reconciliation, exception handling, and data promotion requirements.
* Document data lineage, data quality rules, transformation logic, reference data dependencies, and business rules required to support trusted financial data across enterprise platforms.

* Work with ETL and data integration tools and teams to support modernization of legacy integration processes into scalable, configurable, and metadata\-driven workflows.
* Strong experience supporting cloud\-based data platforms and enterprise data modernization initiatives.

* Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automated deployment processes in cloud environments.

* Actively participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint demos, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Partner with QA to define test scenarios, data validation approaches, reconciliation checks, expected results, and end\-to\-end test coverage for data integration workflows.

This role will provide the opportunity to work with a variety of stakeholders across our firm. You’ll use and learn traditional and innovative tools and techniques to demonstrate how our team can enable positive transformation across our business. We believe it is not a necessity to already have experience in professional services and believe that the more diverse industry experience you bring to the team, the better.


Your role as a Technical Business Analyst (TBA) is to be the “voice of the business” ensuring that our technology teams deliver solutions that meet business needs. You will play a crucial part in transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision\-making across the business. You’ll do this by proactively understanding our business, eliciting requirements, and continually looking for ways to improve the user experience. In addition, your role will support the Head of BA to evolve the practice, including being a role model and leader for other members on the team.


Our Analysts are business and user\-experienced, with excellent relationship management skills and a creative problem\-solving approach.

**Work you'll do**


As a Technical Proj \& Program Mgmt, ICS, Core, USI Support Delivery on the Business Analysis team, you will be responsible for:

* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for new features, enhancements, and process improvements.
* Translate requirements into user stories, functional requirements, process flows, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation aligned to technical design and implementation.
* Partner with developers, architects, product owners, and testers to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguity, and support delivery through Agile ceremonies.
* Document technical constraints, system interactions, data flows, integrations, and application programming interface (API) specifications that may affect solution design and implementation.
* Build stakeholder alignment by facilitating discussions, managing competing priorities, and communicating technical concepts in business terms and business requirements in technical terms.

Join a collaborative Agile team that works closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Architects, Developers, and Test Engineers to deliver innovative technology solutions. As a Technical Business Analyst, you will play a key role in bridging the gap between business and technology, translating complex requirements into clear, actionable user stories and technical specifications. The team values strong stakeholder engagement, problem\-solving, and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to work on system integrations, APIs, process transformation initiatives, and emerging technologies while contributing to meaningful business outcomes in a supportive and fast\-paced environment.

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**

**Qualifications**


Required:

* 8\-10 years of experience as a technical business analyst or in a business analysis role supporting product, application, or technology delivery.
* Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
* Experience working with architects, developers, testers, and product managers across the software development lifecycle.
* Experience reading and interpreting technical artifacts including application programming interface (API) documentation, JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) or Extensible Markup Language (XML) payloads, database schemas, and solution designs.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and requirements management tools such as Azure DevOps.
* Understanding of data modeling, system integrations, and end\-to\-end business process flows.
* Experience documenting interface specifications, data flows, and system interaction diagrams.


Preferred:

* Experience facilitating workshops and requirements sessions with business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience decomposing complex requirements into epics, features, and user stories.
* Experience analyzing and documenting customer journeys, user flows, and interaction models.
* Experience supporting process transformation or user experience improvement initiatives.
* Experience identifying use cases for artificial intelligence\-enabled solutions in business or product environments.
* Experience in professional services is not required.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**  

What You'll Do:

* Product Strategy \& Vision: Develop and articulate a comprehensive product vision and strategy for your assigned product area, aligning it with the company's overall strategic goals. Identify significant market opportunities, evolving customer needs, and complex competitive landscapes to inform product direction.
* Portfolio Ownership: Drive strategy and execution across multiple related product areas, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives and maximizing cross\-product synergies.
* Roadmap Ownership: Own and manage the product roadmap, strategically prioritizing features and initiatives based on long\-term strategic value, significant customer impact, and technical feasibility. Clearly communicate the roadmap to executive stakeholders across the organization.
* Requirements Definition: Translate complex user needs, intricate business requirements, and advanced technical capabilities into detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success teams throughout the product lifecycle. Facilitate effective communication and critical decision\-making to ensure successful product delivery.
* Market \& Customer Research: Conduct thorough market research, competitive analysis, and in\-depth customer interviews to gain profound insights into user behavior, critical pain points, and emerging trends.
* Data\-Driven Performance \& Iteration: Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for your products, rigorously monitor performance, and leverage advanced data\-driven insights to identify areas for substantial improvement and guide future iterations. Comfort with analyzing and interpreting highly complex datasets is essential.
* Stakeholder Management: Build strong, influential relationships with internal and external stakeholders, effectively managing expectations and communicating critical product updates and progress to senior leadership.
* Mentorship: Actively mentor junior and senior product managers, sharing advanced best practices and significantly contributing to the growth and development of the entire product team.

 **Qualifications**  

What You'll Bring:

* Experience: Overall 6\+ years of experience in product management or similar roles within product companies, with a proven track record of successfully launching and scaling complex, impactful products.
* Strategic Thinking: Exceptional ability to think strategically and translate broad, ambitious visions into actionable plans and detailed product requirements.
* Technical Acumen: Deep understanding of software development processes and technologies. Ability to engage in sophisticated technical discussions with engineering teams and guide architectural decisions.
* Analytical Skills: Superior analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to use complex data to drive critical product decisions.
* Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Demonstrated executive presence with the ability to effectively influence and engage senior leadership to drive product strategy and organizational alignment.
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate highly complex ideas clearly and persuasively to diverse, including executive, audiences.
* Collaboration: Proven ability to lead and influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority, fostering a collaborative and high\-performing environment.
* Customer Focus: A profound empathy for users and a passion for creating products that solve significant, real\-world problems.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA a strong plus

 **Additional Information**  

Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

---------------


The Amazon Marketplace is a critical part of the Amazon ecosystem which offers millions of sellers the opportunity to build and grow their business using Amazon’s reach and expertise. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. In our vision to build a global marketplace, we will enable Sellers to list, make their selection available to customers globally while optimizing their inventory placement across multiple countries.  

  

EPR Services on Amazon aims to dramatically transform the way Sellers can fulfil their Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) compliance obligations in the EU, in order to keep selling on Amazon. EPR is an environmental policy that makes Sellers who first places a product subject to EPR requirements in a country responsible for the entire life cycle of the products that they introduce on the market, from their design until the end of life.
  

  

As a Product Ops Manager on the Pay on Behalf team, you will help us set up the product operations needed to ensure compliance reporting and payments for our Sellers. The role will involve working with product, tech, business, legal, compliance authorities and fees stakeholders.

* Actively seek ways to improve product related process efficiencies and effectiveness.
* Proactively identify gaps or blockers to seller experience, propose solutions, and drive implementation across partner teams.

 "
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to develop, implement, and maintain long\-term strategies for high\-potential products in our current and future portfolio, aiming to maximize market share and profitability through strategic planning and execution.
   

  

  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**




 1\. You will be responsible for conducting an in\-depth evaluation of the competitive landscape and identifying opportunities for the organization. This involves defining key success factors and requirements necessary for a successful product launch and owning the product strategy document.

 5\. You will ensure cross\-functional alignment on forecasts, product volume capacity requirements, and launch preparation, including recommendations for long\-term product\-specific capacity investments.
   

  





 6\. You will be accountable for the product's profit and loss (P\&L), including profitability calculation reflecting product\-specific sales and marketing costs and other investments before and after handing over to markets.
   

  





 7\. Your role includes defining and monitoring the life cycle management strategy with development teams and optimizing product allocation for products under supply constraints.
   

  

  

  





 8\. Your responsibilities extend to portfolio optimization and rationalization, involving commercial growth strategies, portfolio rationalization, and conducting in\-depth costing analysis and improvement strategies to enhance overall performance of the product.

**Educational qualification:** 
 MBA
   

  

  

  

**Minimum work experience:** 
 5\-8 years of experience in similar Commercial, Program/Project Management or Strategy roles in Pharma or Lifesciences space

 • Proficiency in managing and coordinating development projects from initiation to completion, including setting project goals, timelines, resource allocation, and risk management.
   

  

 • Experience in preparing for new product launches, including market analysis, competitor research, launch strategy development, and coordination with various departments to ensure successful market entry.
   

  

 • Expertise in overseeing the entire lifecycle of commercial products, including product planning, pricing, positioning, and promotion to maximize profitability and market share.

**The Opportunity** 




  





 Arup Digital Products (ADP) are seeking a Product Manager to lead the strategy, development and delivery of AI and Machine Learning capabilities across Arup’s engineering simulation software portfolio. This role will focus on identifying, scoping and delivering high\-value AI/ML features that enhance engineering productivity, accelerate simulation workflows and unlock new insights from simulation data.

You will collaborate with product, engineering and data science teams in India and the UK, as well as customers worldwide, to embed practical AI/ML capabilities into established CAE workflows used by automotive and aerospace customers.
 



  





 At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
 



  





 You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
 



  





  





**Is this role right for you?** 




  





 We are looking for:
 



  




* Demonstrable experience owning and delivering software products across the full product lifecycle, including discovery, delivery and launch.
* Experience working with AI/ML technologies in a product context, with a strong conceptual understanding of techniques, data requirements, evaluation, validation and practical deployment considerations.
* The ability to translate complex technical and CAE workflow requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and value\-led product narratives.
* Hands\-on experience with agile development methodologies, cross\-functional delivery teams and evidence\-based prioritisation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non\-technical audiences, senior stakeholders and international customers.



  





  





**Reward and Benefits** 




  





 We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance.
 



  





  





**Different people, shared values** 




  





 At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
 



  





 At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks \- BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ\+ and Women \- provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference \- discover more about life at Arup here.
 



  





 At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.
 



 At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.
 



  





  





**What happens next?** 




  





 If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.
 



  





 Stay safe online \- Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

jobs.description:
**Data Management Strategy \& Governance Lead Analyst**

**Role Summary**


The Data Operations Business Analyst is responsible for defining, capturing, and operationalizing **data specifications and business metadata** for **Platinum‑level enterprise data sources**. This role focuses on the detailed documentation of source tables, data structures, lineage, and business meaning, ensuring that critical enterprise data assets are fully specified, governed, and discoverable within enterprise data governance platforms.


The role partners closely with business stakeholders, analytic teams, and data engineering to translate enterprise data assets into **well‑documented, observable, and trusted data products**, with specifications maintained centrally in governance and metadata management tools such as **Collibra**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Specification \& Metadata Capture**

* Lead the identification and documentation of **data specifications** for Platinum‑level enterprise data sources, including:
	+ Source systems and source tables
	+ Key data elements and attributes
	+ Transformation logic and dependencies
	+ End‑to‑end data lineage
* Gather, define, and maintain **business metadata**, including:
	+ Business definitions and terminology
	+ Metric descriptions and business context
	+ Data ownership and stewardship assignments
* Ensure both **business and technical metadata** are complete, accurate, and aligned to enterprise standards.

**Enterprise Data Governance Enablement**

* Ensure all data specifications and metadata are **registered, maintained, and governed** within enterprise data governance tools, with a primary focus on **Collibra**.
* Support governance workflows including:
	+ Data asset onboarding and certification
	+ Business glossary curation
	+ Stewardship reviews and approvals
* Partner with data owners, stewards, and governance teams to ensure Platinum data sources meet **certification, transparency, and auditability expectations**.

**Data Lineage, Architecture \& Observability**

* Work closely with data engineering and platform teams to document **logical and physical data lineage** from source through analytic consumption.
* Capture and maintain **data architecture artifacts** that support impact analysis and change management.
* Partner with engineering to define and automate **data observability specifications and reporting**, aligning quality, freshness, and reliability indicators back to documented data assets.

**Cross‑Functional Partnership**

* Act as a liaison between **business, analytics, governance, and engineering teams**, ensuring consistent understanding of enterprise data definitions and specifications.
* Facilitate specification walkthroughs, design reviews, and metadata validation sessions.
* Support analytic and reporting teams by ensuring Platinum data products are **clearly specified, trusted, and discoverable for reuse**.

**Required Qualifications**

* **5–6 years of experience** in data management, data operations, business analysis, or analytics enablement.
* Strong experience documenting **data specifications**, including source tables, lineage, and metadata.
* Hands‑on experience with **enterprise data governance and metadata tools**, preferably **Collibra**.
* Solid understanding of:
	+ Enterprise data architectures (data warehouse, lakehouse)
	+ Analytic and reporting consumption patterns
	+ Data certification and governed data products
* Ability to translate complex technical structures into **clear business metadata and documentation**.
* Demonstrated experience working with business stakeholders, analytic users, and data engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting **Platinum / Tier‑0 / certified enterprise data sources**.
* Familiarity with **data observability and data reliability concepts**.
* Experience documenting **end‑to‑end lineage and data architectures** in complex enterprise environments.
* Exposure to regulated or compliance‑driven data domains.
* Experience working within a **DataOps or product‑oriented data organization**.

**Key Competencies**

* Data specification and metadata management
* Business and technical translation
* Governance‑first mindset
* Attention to detail and data accuracy
* Cross‑functional collaboration and influence

We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

The successful candidate will partner closely with business process owners, data stewards, SAP functional teams, integration teams, and enterprise data governance stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust MDG solutions. This person will serve as a strategic architecture authority for SAP MDG and will help establish a sustainable foundation for data quality, operational efficiency, compliance, and digital transformation.


Main responsibilities:


Key Responsibilities


* Define and maintain the end\-to\-end SAP MDG solution architecture across master data domains, including Business Partner, Customer, Supplier, Material, Finance, and custom objects.
* Lead solution design for SAP MDG data models, change request processes, workflow design, UI configuration, validations, derivations, duplicate checks, and governance controls.
* Design and oversee integration and replication strategies between SAP MDG, SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and non\-SAP applications using appropriate technologies such as DRF, IDocs, APIs, middleware, and data integration platforms.
* Partner with data governance leaders, business process owners, and data stewards to define master data standards, ownership models, approval workflows, and data quality rules.
* Provide architectural leadership during SAP S/4HANA transformation, MDG implementation, consolidation, migration, deployment, and hypercare activities.
* Establish reusable MDG design standards, playbooks, templates, documentation, and solution governance practices.
* Guide technical and functional teams through design, build, testing, deployment, issue resolution, and continuous improvement activities.
* Support data migration and data quality initiatives, including profiling, cleansing, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and cutover readiness.
* Evaluate SAP MDG enhancements, SAP Fiori capabilities, SAP BTP integration options, data quality tools, and automation opportunities to improve master data operations.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders by presenting solution options, trade\-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly and confidently.

About you:


* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Management, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* 10\+ years of experience in SAP data management, master data management, enterprise data architecture, or SAP solution delivery.
* 7\+ years of hands\-on SAP MDG experience, including at least one full lifecycle SAP MDG implementation or major enhancement program.
* Strong knowledge of SAP MDG Central Governance, data modeling, change request workflows, BRF\+ rules, validations, derivations, data replication, and governance configuration.
* Experience with master data domains such as Business Partner, Customer, Supplier, Material, Finance, and custom master data objects.
* Demonstrated experience integrating SAP MDG with SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and non\-SAP systems.
* Strong understanding of data governance frameworks, data ownership models, data stewardship, data quality management, and enterprise master data lifecycle processes.
* Ability to facilitate workshops, translate business requirements into solution architecture, and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and decision\-making skills.

Preferred Qualifications


* SAP MDG certification or relevant SAP S/4HANA certification.
* Experience in regulated industries such as pharmaceuticals, consumer healthcare, life sciences, or manufacturing.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA transformations, global template design, multi\-country rollouts, or enterprise harmonization programs.
* Knowledge of SAP Fiori, Floorplan Manager, SAP Business Workflow, SAP BTP, SAP Data Services, SAP Information Steward, SAP Data Intelligence, or other data quality and integration tools.
* Experience with agile delivery methods, product ownership, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar delivery platforms.
* Experience mentoring consultants, architects, developers, analysts, or data stewardship teams.

The Principal, Data Stewardship is a hands\-on individual contributor responsible for supporting data quality, stewardship execution, and operational readiness across assigned master data domains.  Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

* Feature Definition: Develop detailed product specifications and communicate them effectively to development and QA teams.
* Value Delivery: Assess business value, create cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes to maximize impact.
* Release Management: Drive product release planning, set delivery expectations, and ensure timely rollout of new functionalities.
* Product Mindset: Serve as a product ambassador internally and externally, sharing domain expertise and addressing stakeholder questions.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Strong knowledge of U.S. healthcare domain, including members, providers, networks, claims, payments, EDI transactions, and HIPAA compliance.
* Proven ability to manage dynamic healthcare products that evolve through continuous refinements and member feedback.
* In‑depth expertise in product management and agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe).
* 8\+ years of experience in product development or ownership.
* Experience in collaborating with diverse technical development and QA teams.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
* Skilled at balancing and managing conflicting stakeholder priorities.
* Hands‑on experience with tools such as Confluence, Jira, Rally, and AI‑driven product management solutions.


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in healthcare, technology, or related discipline.
* Proficiency with modern product management tools and technologies.
* SAFe POPM certification (or equivalent).
* U.S. healthcare certifications in provider networks, claims, or compliance.

 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to you…

jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for
 **end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains** 
 . This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
   

  

 The Lead Product Owner acts as the
 **central accountability point across a portfolio of related products** 
 , coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
   

  

 This role is critical to enabling
 **product‑led execution at scale** 
 within the CDO.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**
* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:
+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.


**Leadership \& Coaching**
* Lead, mentor, and coach Product Owners to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Business Partnership**
* Serve as an interface between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into sequenced, realistic roadmaps.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.


**Roadmap, Backlog \& Delivery Governance**
* Maintain a portfolio‑level roadmap, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:
+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.


**Quality, Governance \& Trust**
* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:
+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
+ Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.


**Value Realization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:
+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency
+ Improve scalability and user experience

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.


**Preferred**
* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.


**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**
* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
 **scale product‑led execution without chaos** 
 , reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

jobs.description:
Data Analyst
Location: Hyderabad
Shift: US business hours overlap
Experience: 3 to 6 years
The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst for a US healthcare business. The data already lands in BigQuery and thepipelines are looked after by the engineering team. Your job starts after that: work out what data we actually have, what is worth paying attention to, and what it is telling us.This is an analysis and insight role with a data science lean. You will be expected to find your own wayaround the warehouse, pull and shape data yourself, build the dashboards that matter, and then gofurther than the dashboard. Why did a number move. Is it correlation or causation. What happens next.
You will work directly with US leadership, including the CEO, and be asked open questions rather thanhanded specifications.**Responsibilities*** Understanding the data
* Explore what data exists across BigQuery and other sources, and build a working view of what isavailable, how reliable it is, and where the gaps are
* Identify which data is genuinely useful for the questions the business is asking
* Recommend what should be monitored on an ongoing basis, and why Pull and manipulate data in raw form without waiting on the engineering team

**Analysis and insight*** Turn data into clear observations and recommendations, not just charts
* Investigate why a metric moved: form a hypothesis, test it against the data, report the result in
* plain language
* Distinguish correlation from causation, and be explicit about which one you have
* Run cohort, segmentation, trend and outlier analysis across clinical, operational, member and growth data
* Deliver ad hoc analysis for US leadership on short turnaround

**Dashboards and monitoring*** Build dashboards in Looker, Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau covering the metrics that matter
* Own them after launch: monitor them, catch anomalies, breaks and trend changes before
* stakeholders do
* Retire or rebuild reporting that nobody uses or nobody trusts
* Testing and predictive work
* Design and run tests to establish what is driving a result
* Apply statistical methods appropriately: significance testing, regression, confidence intervals
* Build forecasting and predictive models where they add value, and be honest about their limits
* Measure the impact of business changes after they are made

**Working with the business*** Turn vague business questions into answerable data questions
* Say when the data cannot support the conclusion someone wants, and what it would take to get
* there
* Present findings to non\-technical executives in writing and live
* Work with the data engineering team on definitions, quality issues and new data requirements


Must have* 3 to 6 years in data analysis, business intelligence or data science
* Strong SQL: joins, window functions, CTEs, aggregation across large tables
* Comfortable working in BigQuery, or another cloud warehouse with the ability to pick BigQuery up
* quickly
* Python for analysis: pandas, numpy, and at least one of scikit\-learn, statsmodels or similar
* Applied statistics: hypothesis testing, significance, regression, and knowing when each applies
* Hands on with at least one BI tool: Looker, Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau
* Can walk through an analysis they ran end to end: the question, the hypothesis, the method, and
* what the business did as a result
* Self directed. Comfortable being given a business problem rather than a ticket
* Strong spoken and written English, comfortable presenting to US stakeholders
* Available for US hours overlap


Good to have* US healthcare data: EHR, claims, eligibility, pharmacy or PBM feeds
* Experience with predictive modelling or forecasting in a production business setting
* Experimentation and A/B testing background
* Exposure to finance or unit economics data: cost per member, cohort retention, revenue drivers
* dbt or Dataform familiarity, enough to read and extend existing models
* Experience as the first or only analyst in a business

**About LJI** 




 Loyalty Juggernaut (LJI) is a leading B2B SaaS company redefining how enterprises drive customer engagement and loyalty. Our flagship platform, GRAVTY®, enables global brands to transform loyalty programs into measurable, revenue\-generating growth engines.
 



 Built as an AI\-first, next\-generation solution, GRAVTY® empowers organizations to deliver highly personalized, real\-time experiences at scale—helping them increase customer lifetime value and deepen brand relationships.
 



 Headquartered in Palo Alto, California, LJI partners with leading enterprises across 16 major industries including airlines, retail, hospitality, financial services and telecommunications powering some of the most innovative loyalty ecosystems worldwide.
 



  





**Our Global Impact:** 



* 400\+ Million members connected through our platform.
* 100\+ Global Brands trust us to drive loyalty and brand devotion.
* 3\-Time Winner of “Best Technology Innovation in Loyalty”.
* Global recognitions for Excellence in Loyalty Management under numerous categories.
* Recognized as a ‘Strong performer’ in The Forrester Wave™ Loyalty Platforms, Q4 2025\.



  





 Explore more about us at www.lji.io.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking a data\-driven Analyst to help clients maximize the value of their loyalty programs through actionable insights and data\-backed recommendations. This role will work closely with our enterprise clients and cross\-functional teams to deliver reporting, analytics, and strategic insights that drive customer engagement and business growth.
 



**What you will OWN:** 



* **BI \& Dashboard Management:** 
 Design, build, and maintain scalable dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using SQL and BI tools to track business, product, and loyalty program KPIs while ensuring data quality and accuracy.
* **Customer \& Loyalty Analytics:** 
 Conduct deep\-dive customer analytics—including segmentation, retention, cohort analysis, churn modeling, and program performance—to measure and drive engagement.
* **Loyalty Economics \& Financial Analysis:** 
 Analyze core program economics, such as earn\-burn ratios, redemption trends, liability, breakage, and financial impact metrics.
* **Client Engagement \& Strategic Consulting:** 
 Partner with client stakeholders to define success metrics, translate business questions into analytical solutions, and deliver data\-driven recommendations through executive reviews and compelling data storytelling.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to translate insights into product enhancements and support ad\-hoc business reviews.
* **Process Automation \& Documentation:** 
 Identify opportunities to automate analytics workflows and report efficiency while maintaining clear documentation for data models, business logic, and client deliverables.



  





**To be successful in this role, you should have** 



* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
* Upto 3 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Reporting, or a similar role.
* Strong SQL and database fundamentals.
* Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of data warehousing, ETL processes, and dimensional modeling.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks.
* Basic knowledge of Python, R, or other analytical programming languages is a plus.
* Understanding of Agile methodologies and ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical, logical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong stakeholders’ communication skills including articulation and presentation skills.
* Exposure to enterprise SaaS products or customer loyalty programs is preferred.



  





**Key Competencies:** 



* Data Analysis \& Visualization
* Business Requirement Gathering
* SQL \& Database Management
* Problem Solving \& Root Cause Analysis
* Stakeholder Communication
* Attention to Detail
* Collaboration \& Teamwork
* Customer\-Centric Mindset



  





**Why join us?** 



* Work with leading global brands and large\-scale loyalty programs.
* Opportunity to solve complex business and data challenges.
* Collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge loyalty technology and analytics.
* Strong growth and learning opportunities within a rapidly expanding organization.

TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long\-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer\-focused environment where people can do their best work.
 



**Product Manager** 




*TechGrove AI Engineering Pod* 




 You are the person who makes a great engineering team feel effortless. You turn priorities into a clean backlog, protect the team’s focus, remove obstacles before they become blockers, and give leadership a calm, honest view of progress and risk. You love shipping, and you measure yourself by what the team delivers.
 



 As Product Manager  you own the delivery engine of an AI Engineering Pod. You are not the Product Owner: the OpCo keeps ownership of product vision and prioritization. You are accountable for turning that vision into shipped features. You own the backlog, drive the cadence, and run the pod as a high\-performing, AI\-native Agile team.
 



 If you want to run delivery for a small, senior team building with AI at its core, this role is for you.
 


**About the Pod** 

 A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self\-contained, AI\-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan’s AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match.
 



 A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high\-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan’s India\-based TechGrove.
 


**What You Will Do** 
* **Own feature delivery:** 
 Own end\-to\-end delivery from backlog to production, accountable for the pod consistently shipping high\-quality software against the Product Owner’s priorities.
* **Manage the backlog:** 
 Own and groom the product backlog, translating the Product Owner’s vision into well\-formed, ready\-to\-build user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* **Facilitate Agile:** 
 Run the pod’s ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, retrospectives), protecting focus, removing impediments, and continuously improving throughput.
* **Align stakeholders:** 
 Serve as the primary delivery interface between the pod and OpCo stakeholders, managing expectations and communicating progress, risks, and trade\-offs.
* **Champion AI\-native delivery:** 
 Adapt Agile practice for a team that builds with agentic tooling (Claude Code and similar): how work is decomposed, estimated, reviewed, and accepted when much of the build is AI\-driven.
* **Drive predictability with metrics:** 
 Establish and track delivery metrics (velocity, cycle time, quality), and use the data to forecast, surface risk early, and drive predictable outcomes.
* **Manage risk and dependencies:** 
 Identify and manage cross\-team dependencies, delivery risks, and blockers, escalating and resolving them to keep the pod moving.
* **Uphold the definition of done:** 
 Ensure features are tested, secure, and production\-ready before release.


**What You Bring** 
* **Experience:** 
 5\+ years in product management, delivery management, and/or Scrum Master roles for software engineering teams, with a track record of shipping production software.
* **Agile mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on command of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and the facilitation skills to run a high\-performing delivery team. CSM/PSM or equivalent is a plus.
* **Backlog and requirements:** 
 Proven ability to manage a product backlog and translate vision into clear, buildable user stories and acceptance criteria.
* **Technical fluency:** 
 Strong technical literacy to work credibly with senior and principal engineers: software architecture, APIs, cloud\-native delivery, and modern SDLC trade\-offs.
* **AI fluency:** 
 Hands\-on familiarity with AI\-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) and a clear point of view on how agentic development changes workflow, estimation, and quality practices.
* **Stakeholder management:** 
 Exceptional communication, with a proven ability to align business and technical stakeholders and manage competing priorities.
* **Ownership and ambiguity:** 
 A proactive ownership mindset and comfort operating amid the ambiguity and rapid change of embedded, fast\-moving delivery teams.


**Nice to Have** 
* Experience leading delivery for B2B or enterprise SaaS products.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional\-services, or embedded\-team model serving external client organizations.
* Familiarity with application modernization or re\-platforming programs.
* Experience defining delivery metrics and reporting for executive stakeholders.


**What Success Looks Like** 
* **First 90 days:** 
 The pod has a clean, prioritized backlog, a steady cadence, and clear metrics, and OpCo stakeholders have a predictable, trusted view of delivery.
* **First 6 months:** 
 Delivery is consistent and forecastable, the team’s AI\-native ways of working are tuned and improving, and stakeholders rely on the pod to deliver.


**Why TechGrove, Why Banyan** 
* **Permanent home, long\-term thinking:** 
 Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip.
* **Real ownership:** 
 You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the “what”; the pod owns the “how.”

 You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build.

No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
   

  

 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!
   

  

**What’s next?**

jobs.description:
Role Overview
   


 The Product Manager owns the vision, strategy, and roadmap for digital and AI\-enabled products serving the Operations function. This role bridges business strategy and technology execution — defining what to build, why to build it, and how it delivers measurable value across the Operations value chain. The Product Manager works closely with Operations stakeholders, Data Scientists, and Engineering teams to ship impactful capabilities.
   




 Key Responsibilities
   


**Product Strategy \& Roadmap**




 • Define and own the product vision and multi\-quarter roadmap for AI and digital products within the Operations domain
   





 • Identify and prioritise product opportunities based on business impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment
   





 • Translate Operations pain points and opportunities into a coherent product strategy
   





 • Communicate roadmap and product direction to senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams
   





**Discovery \& Backlog Management**




 • Lead product discovery activities including user research, journey mapping, and opportunity assessment
   





 • Maintain a well\-groomed, prioritised product backlog aligned to business value
   





 • Write clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with Business Analysts
   





 • Make prioritisation decisions based on data, stakeholder input, and strategic objectives
   





**Delivery Collaboration**




 • Act as the primary product authority within Agile delivery teams
   





 • Partner with Data Scientists to define AI product requirements, evaluate model outputs, and validate business value
   





 • Collaborate with Engineering and Architecture on technical feasibility and trade\-offs
   





 • Drive sprint reviews, demos, and feedback cycles with Operations stakeholders
   





**Outcomes \& Performance**




 • Define and track product KPIs and OKRs to measure adoption, efficiency gains, and business value realisation
   





 • Gather and synthesise post\-launch feedback to inform iterative improvement
   





 • Champion a data\-driven and user\-centric product culture within the team
   




 Qualifications \& Experience
   


 • 7–12 years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise operations or supply chain systems
   





 • Proven ability to define product strategy, manage roadmaps, and drive end\-to\-end delivery
   





 • Strong experience with Agile methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence, Productboard)
   





 • Familiarity with AI/ML product development — understanding of model capabilities, limitations, and operationalisation

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience programming in C\+\+.
* 7 years of experience building and developing large\-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage, or hardware architecture.
* 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 5 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.
* Expertise within cloud storage or cloud infrastructure.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



Persistent Disk, Google Cloud’s block storage solution, provides reliable, exceptional storage solutions for low latency sensitive and high throughput workloads. Persistent Disk provides data protection capabilities that allow workloads to choose disaster recovery, high availability, and backup.


In this role, you will be a technical leader who innovates in this space with building a team that is delivering world\-leading performance for Google's PD Backup family of products, and lead Persistent Disk/Hyperdisk's IO Performance team.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Full Stack Software Engineer**

**What we do at Weir**  

We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

**Make your impact**  

You’ll play a key role in solving real\-world challenges. You’ll apply your skills to deliver results that matter whether that’s through engineering, planning or customer support. You’ll work with purpose, learn every day and help shape a more sustainable future.

**What you’ll do**

* **Software Development:** Design, develop, test, and deploy backend services, frontend applications, and integrations with a strong focus on maintainability, performance, security, and usability. Daily work involves hands\-on coding primarily in .NET / ASP.NET Core, Node.js, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. Success means delivering secure, scalable, and production\-ready software that meets functional and operational requirements.
* **Low\-Code Platform Contribution:** Spend about 20% of your time contributing to development within a low\-code digital twin and application platform (such as XMPRO), including solution configuration, application logic, and integration of custom components. While prior experience with XMPRO is not required, familiarity with similar tools like Grafana or Tableau is valuable.
* **Frontend Engineering:** Lead frontend development (approximately 40% of the role) using React and Next.js or similar frameworks, building user\-friendly, consistent, and maintainable UI components. Flexibility is essential as requirements evolve during development.
* **Technical Leadership:** Provide technical leadership through hands\-on development, mentoring team members, and fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, and continuous learning. While architectural skills are a plus, the primary focus is on strong software engineering execution.
* **Collaboration \& Agile Delivery:** Work closely with cross\-functional teams including product owners, DevOps, QA, and other engineers in an agile environment to refine requirements and deliver high\-quality software.
* **Release \& Deployment:** Support modern release practices such as feature flags, blue\-green deployments, and production readiness, working with containerized applications and cloud\-hosted environments.
* **Travel Requirements:** Some international travel may be required depending on current guidelines, with flexibility to work non\-standard hours due to the global nature of the role.
* **Safety First:** Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world\-class safety culture.

**What you’ll bring**

**Must\-haves:**

* Excellent hands\-on experience in full stack software development with expertise in .NET / ASP.NET Core, Node.js, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
* Proven ability to develop backend APIs, frontend components, and integrations in collaborative, agile teams.
* Experience or exposure to low\-code or configurable application platforms such as XMPRO, Grafana, Tableau, or PI Vision, with a strong willingness and ability to learn new tools quickly.
* Excellent communication skills to clearly explain technical concepts and collaborate effectively across diverse team.

**Nice\-to\-haves:**

* Experience with software design and architecture practices including clean architecture, domain\-driven design, and secure coding.
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, and cloud\-hosted deployments.
* Background in industrial digital, IIoT, or data\-intensive systems, especially in mining, minerals processing, or heavy industry sectors.
* Additional programming skills in languages like Go or Python.
* Prior experience in technical leadership or mentoring roles.

**Why join Weir?**  

We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.

  

We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world\-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end\-to\-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.

  

We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

* Competitive pay
* Career development and learning support

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil \& gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.
 



 Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two\-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000\+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.
 



 Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.
 



  
 



**Product Manager** 





**\*\*This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Bangalore location\*\*** 





 We are looking for a Product Manager who embraces an AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), using AI throughout the product lifecycle to accelerate innovation, improve product quality, and deliver measurable customer outcomes. You will use AIDLC to lead the strategy and execution of capabilities across our Product Experience Management (PXM) platform while identifying opportunities to automate workflows, improve data quality, and enhance customer productivity at scale.
 



**HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY** 



* Define functional and non\-functional requirements and recommend solutions in the form of POCs, prototypes, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to groom stories and iterate on prototypes throughout the release cycle.
* Act as a proxy for the business throughout development, testing, and release activities to ensure business needs are met.
* Develop business analysis artifacts, such as business rules and process flows, to clarify requirements.
* Coordinate with other departments in advance of feature and product launches to develop messaging that supports and promotes new releases, features, and updates.
* Conduct product training internally and externally, including training internal trainers, developing new product and feature documentation, and introducing new functionality to internal employees and key customers.
* Provide consistency and clarity to development projects by identifying business needs and constraints, defining scope, and ensuring efficient execution.
* Design product processes that move initiatives forward using AI tooling.
* Advance the use of AI and autonomous agents to transform and accelerate the product development lifecycle.



**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU** 



* 4–5 years of Product Management experience building and scaling enterprise SaaS products.
* Proven experience operating within an AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), leveraging AI across discovery, requirements, design, delivery, and product optimization.
* Demonstrated track record of defining, launching, and scaling AI\-powered features, agents, automation workflows, or intelligent recommendation systems.
* Hands\-on experience using Generative AI and LLM\-based tools to accelerate product management workflows, improve decision\-making, and increase team productivity.
* Strong understanding of AI product patterns, including LLMs, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Ability to identify high\-value automation opportunities and translate them into measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Data\-driven mindset with experience defining success metrics, evaluating AI outcomes, and driving continuous product improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, implementation\-ready product requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to lead cross\-functional teams without formal authority.
* Experience in PIM, PXM, DAM, Syndication, eCommerce, Retail, CPG, Manufacturing, or Distribution domains (preferred but not required).



  
 


**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion** 

 To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.
 



 Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 
 



 All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

 At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

We are seeking a seasoned Technical Product Owner to guide the evolution of our high\-traffic Sports and News mobile applications, working in close partnership with the Product Owner. This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between business objectives, user needs, and technical execution, with a primary focus on backend systems and APIs. A core responsibility will be empowering our Scrum teams by meticulously refining user stories related to these backend components, ensuring they are clear, concise, and fully prepared for development sprints, thereby maximizing team velocity and product quality.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Product Vision \& Roadmap Collaboration: Collaborate with the Product Owner and product leadership to define and articulate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Sports and News mobile applications, ensuring alignment with company goals and technical feasibility.
* Backlog Management \& Prioritization (Backend Focus): In partnership with the Product Owner, manage, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog for the mobile apps, with a specific focus on backend services, APIs, and their integration with the mobile front\-end. Ensure the backlog is transparent, well\-understood, and reflects the highest value opportunities.
* Story Refinement \& Readiness (Backend \& API Emphasis): Lead and facilitate rigorous backlog refinement sessions, particularly for backend\-focused user stories, with the Scrum development team (engineers, QA, designers). This includes:
* Breaking down epics and larger features related to backend systems and APIs into granular, well\-defined user stories.
* Clearly articulating functional requirements, technical specifications, and user needs for backend services.
* Defining precise, testable acceptance criteria for API endpoints and backend logic.
* Ensuring all backend stories meet the team's agreed\-upon "Definition of Ready" (DoR) before sprint planning, minimizing ambiguity and enabling efficient development.
* Technical Liaison \& API Definition: Act as the primary technical point of contact for the mobile development team and backend engineering teams, translating business requirements into actionable technical tasks for APIs and services, and providing necessary context. Contribute to the design and definition of new APIs and backend services, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and meet the functional and non\-functional requirements of the mobile applications.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with various stakeholders, including the Product Owner, business units, editorial teams, marketing, and UX/UI designers, to gather requirements, solicit feedback, and ensure alignment. Act as a key liaison between the Product Owner and the engineering teams for backend initiatives.
* Agile Process Facilitation: Actively participate in all Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives), providing ongoing clarification and support to the team, especially regarding backend and API implementations.
* Quality Assurance Support (Backend \& API): Work closely with QA to ensure test ability of backend features and API integrations, and validate that implemented solutions meet acceptance criteria.
* Performance Monitoring (Backend Systems): Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to backend service health, API response times, and data integrity, as well as user feedback, to inform future iterations and identify areas for improvement.



  





 Requirements
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in a Product Owner, Technical Product Manager, or similar role, with a significant portion focused on backend systems or API development within mobile application contexts.
* Proven experience working within an Agile/Scrum framework, with a strong emphasis on backlog grooming and story refinement techniques, particularly for backend services.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear, concise, and comprehensive user stories and acceptance criteria for backend functionalities and APIs.
* Solid understanding of the mobile application development lifecycle (iOS and/or Android) and how it interfaces with backend systems.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience with backlog management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
* Analytical mindset with a passion for data\-driven decision\-making.
* Preferred Qualifications:
* Experience working on high\-volume consumer\-facing applications, particularly in the Sports or News media domain.
* Technical background or a strong understanding of mobile technologies, RESTful APIs, microservices, and system integrations.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification.



  





 Benefits
 



 What We Offer
 


* Competitive salaries and comprehensive health benefits
* Flexible work hours and remote work options
* Professional development and training opportunities
* A supportive and inclusive work environment
* Access to cutting\-edge technology and tools.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
 Business analyst role in a hybrid work model focusing on digital product initiatives that use mobile technologies such as Flutter and iOS. The role involves analyzing business processes defining clear requirements and collaborating with cross functional teams to deliver user centered solutions that align with organizational goals and create positive impact for customers and society.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyze current and future business processes to identify gaps and opportunities where mobile solutions built with Flutter and iOS can improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to elicit clear business needs and translate them into structured requirements that guide mobile feature development and align with strategic objectives.
* Document detailed user stories acceptance criteria and workflows that describe how customers and internal users will interact with Flutter and iOS applications in a day to day context.
* Facilitate requirement walkthroughs and clarification sessions with designers and engineers to ensure shared understanding of business goals and minimize rework during implementation.
* Assess the impact of proposed mobile changes on upstream and downstream systems and define dependencies to support smooth integration across enterprise platforms.
* Develop analytical models and simple metrics that track performance of mobile features and provide insight into how digital experiences contribute to business value.
* Prepare functional specifications and configuration guidelines that describe expected behaviors of mobile applications in normal and edge case scenarios for day shift operations.
* Conduct business focused reviews of mobile application prototypes and test results to confirm that implemented features meet documented requirements and provide usable experiences.
* Support defect triage activities by analyzing reported issues reproducing relevant scenarios and recommending business oriented resolutions that protect customer trust.
* Engage with hybrid team members through structured workshops and remote collaboration routines to maintain alignment on priorities and upcoming releases without requiring travel.
* Create clear reports and summaries that communicate key findings requirement changes and delivery status to stakeholders in language that supports decision making.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons from each mobile release and proposing enhancements that make business analysis practices more effective.
* Ensure that all analysis activities follow organizational standards for quality compliance and ethics so that delivered solutions serve the broader interests of society.


**Qualifications**
* Possess practical experience in business analysis for digital or mobile products with three to six years of progressively responsible work in hybrid environments.
* Demonstrate hands on exposure to Flutter based application initiatives with the ability to discuss business needs using terminology that mobile engineers and product teams understand.
* Show relevant experience working with iOS application projects including requirement definition for user interfaces navigation flows and data interactions.
* Apply strong analytical and problem solving capabilities to interpret complex stakeholder input and convert it into structured requirements that guide development.
* Use clear and inclusive communication skills to collaborate with diverse teams and document business artifacts that are easy to understand and maintain.
* Exhibit familiarity with standard business analysis practices such as process mapping requirement prioritization and acceptance criteria definition using practical tools.
* Display awareness of hybrid work practices and the ability to manage time and tasks effectively during day shifts while coordinating with onsite and remote colleagues.
